footprint_source: Google Open Buildings v3 polygons confidence >=0.70; centroid inside AOI
footprint_polygon_status: Original detected footprint, NOT roof material confirmed and NOT corrected
annual_rain_source: CHIRPS v3 daily RNL 1996-2025; mean annual rainfall at native CHIRPS pixel of building centroid
historical_daily_source: CHIRPS v3 daily RNL 1996-2025 spatial AOI aggregation, not rooftop weather record
provenance_note: Do not merge aoi_mean_rainfall_proxy RWH values from earlier exploratory output with newer pixel-sampled RWH values.
unclipped_geometry_note: Footprints selected by centroid inside AOI; polygons along AOI boundary may cross the line, and their full reported area is used.
baseline_product: Theoretical rooftop catchment, not potable yield
quality_module: Scenario advisory only; no automated potability approval
daily_first_flush_sensitivity: Optional daily event proxy, NOT measured rainfall events
